description: This file contains utility functions for the backend API, including functions to generate unique IDs, obtain current UTC timestamps, serialize data to canonical JSON, compute SHA-256 hashes, and create standard error responses.

methods.name: str generate_id(prefix: str = "")
methods.description: Generate a unique identifier with an optional prefix.

methods.name: str utc_now_iso()
methods.description: Get current UTC timestamp in ISO-8601 format with trailing 'Z'.

methods.name: str canonical_json(data: Any)
methods.description: Serialize data to canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace).

methods.name: str compute_hash(data: Any)
methods.description: Compute SHA-256 hash of input data, handling strings and JSON data types.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] make_error_response(code: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, details: Dict[str, Any] = None)
methods.description: Create a standard error response dictionary with code, message, correlation ID, optional details, and timestamp.

ctags.name: make_error_response
ctags.pattern: /^def make_error_response(code: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, details: Dict[str, Any] = /
ctags.signature: (code: str, message: str, correlation_id: str, details: Dict[str, Any] = None)
